# EUR-Lex fixtures

Excerpts of the EUR-Lex HTML documents listed in `data/sources.toml`, used as parser test
input. They were cut and re-serialized with Beautiful Soup, so text and structure are
unchanged, but formatting details of the markup may differ from the original bytes. Each file
names its source CELEX number and the case it covers in a comment at the top.

© European Union, reused under Decision 2011/833/EU (see `docs/data-licenses.md`).

`oj_*` files use the Official Journal layout, `cons_*` files the consolidated layout.
